## Thesis writing

I advise many students writing Master's theses. I've written a guide, [Writing a
Master's Thesis In Four Not-So-Easy Steps](/teaching/thesiswritingguide.pdf),
collecting my advice for students about to write a Master's thesis.

Here's a link to an [M.Sc. Thesis
Template](https://www.overleaf.com/read/hzsxfpdvjqzs).
